Overview
As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician Manager (DIAM), you will lead a team of Inventory & Asset Management technicians responsible for inbound/outbound logistics tasks, inventory cycle audits, and Data Center regulatory compliance activities. You will guide your employees to effectively run warranty processes and data bearing device (DBD) destruction. This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, drive focus on accurately and efficiently completing Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks, and work with stakeholders to manage escalations as they arise.
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
Responsibilities
- Managers help deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring while promoting a positive and effective team culture.
- Responsible for overall day-to-day operations and ensure inbound and outbound processes are running smoothly and effectively.
- Assess resource and workflow patterns to determine any needed changes in work assignments to ensure timelines are met.
- Support the planning, management, and communication of end-to-end project plans with applicable stakeholders and teams.
- Ensure that all issues are documented, tracked, discussed, and resolved with internal and external stakeholders as well as suppliers with consistent and complete communication.
- Coordinate and oversee relationships with any third-party vendors who perform DBD destruction as necessary ensuring all DBDs leaving premises do not contain customer information and are destroyed.
- Comply with established methodologies and approaches to ensure delivery and execution of contracts and purchase orders.
- Process price and procurement requests requested by Microsoft management in support of server, network, Storage Area Network (SAN), and spare requirements.
- Provide thought leadership on established methodologies and monitor outcome.
- Serve as subject matter expert and model compliance to junior team members.
- Conduct or assist in conducting daily safety briefings, completes required safety training, provides guidance to technicians to facilitate compliance with safety procedures (e.g., Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage, rack moving, heavy-equipment usage, lifting, ladder/rolling stair use).
- Seek out opportunities to contribute to workstreams and evolve existing workstream processes, services, and solutions toward greater simplification and automation.
- Embody our culture and values.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- High School Diploma AND 3+ year(s) experience warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, inventory management, retail, warehouse management, logistics, or a related field.- OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements: 
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 
- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:
- 5+ year(s) experience in warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, IT, and/or logistics, operating heavy-load movement equipment (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, chassis lifts) for a large corporation- OR equivalent experience.

- 1+ year(s) project management experience.
- Certification in American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS)/Association for Supply Chain Management (ASCM), International Association of Information Technology Asset Managers (IAITAM), Inventory Control, OR equivalent.
 
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. De plus, vous réaliserez des opérations de dépannage et de diagnostic sur les équipements, ainsi que des mises hors service de matériel pour des modifications simples et des renouvellements, conformément aux procédures opérationnelles standard. Cette opportunité vous permettra d’approfondir votre compréhension des processus et procédures standards des centres de données, de développer des compétences en mentorat tout en guidant vos collègues, de vous familiariser avec les procédures de sécurité et de gestion des données, et d’accélérer votre progression professionnelle.

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) Québec City, you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.
 
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
 
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 
Requirements of the Role: This job will require you to, among other things, occasionally climb ladders, frequently climb stairs and/or ramps, engage in prolonged standing, occasionally engage in lifting (up to 50lbs./22.5kg), occasionally engage in pushing or pulling (of up to 50-75lbs. / 22.5-34kg) that may be assisted or unassisted with an assistive device, and regularly and frequently exercise fine hand manipulation.
 
In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time.

Responsibilities
Opérations du Centre de Données
- Respecte les politiques, procédures et délais de l’unité commerciale du centre de données, avec l’accompagnement de techniciens expérimentés et/ou de la hiérarchie directe. Remonte les problèmes liés à la conformité ou aux activités d’assurance opérationnelle à la hiérarchie directe.
- Traite les tickets assignés de manière efficace et conforme aux indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) pertinents selon le type de tâche, de façon autonome. Fournit des conseils et/ou assiste les techniciens moins expérimentés sur des tickets ou des tâches complexes, et escalade de manière appropriée les tickets difficiles ou complexes aux techniciens plus expérimentés si nécessaire.
- Démontre une compréhension appliquée des processus et procédures standards pour la préparation, l’installation, le diagnostic, le dépannage, le remplacement et/ou la mise hors service des technologies et équipements informatiques du centre de données. Démontre une compréhension fondamentale des fonctions et des interactions entre l’infrastructure de câblage, le réseau, les serveurs et les équipements de stockage.
- Examine les notifications de changement de processus (PCN) et développe une compréhension de leur impact sur l’exécution du travail ainsi qu’une sensibilisation aux changements dans son domaine d’activité et/ou celui des autres. Pose des questions lorsqu’il/elle ne dispose pas des informations nécessaires et peut fournir des retours sur les changements de processus aux techniciens expérimentés et/ou à la hiérarchie directe.
 
Environnement de travail en centre de données
- Contribue à un environnement d’équipe positif et efficace en partageant des informations avec les autres équipes ou équipes de techniciens sur différents créneaux, en participant aux réunions d’équipe régulières, en posant des questions et en collaborant avec les autres équipes pour assurer une transition fluide et une passation efficace des tâches assignées. Fournit, reçoit et encourage les retours d’expérience sur les moyens d’améliorer l’efficacité du travail au sein de l’équipe, et adopte les meilleures pratiques partagées entre les équipes et les différents créneaux horaires.
- Suit les formations obligatoires en matière de sécurité et de gestion des données tout en respectant les procédures et politiques associées, avec l’accompagnement d’autres techniciens. Peut accompagner des prestataires externes ou du support informatique sur site dans les centres de données ou les sites réseau. Prend les mesures appropriées et signale toute préoccupation ou incident lié à l’accès physique à la sécurité à la hiérarchie directe ou via les méthodes de signalement établies.
- Participe aux briefings quotidiens sur la sécurité. Suit les formations obligatoires en matière d’environnement et de santé/sécurité (EHS), respecte les procédures de sécurité (par exemple : utilisation d’équipements, levage, risques électriques, utilisation d’échelles ou escaliers roulants), réalise les analyses de risques liées aux tâches (THA) requises, et utilise les équipements et les équipements de protection individuelle (EPI) appropriés pour les tâches assignées. Adopte et promeut une culture de la sécurité, en prenant des mesures proactives pour alerter les autres en cas de préoccupations, quasi-accidents ou incidents. Participe régulièrement aux processus et systèmes de signalement proactif des observations de sécurité.
- Comme indiqué ci-dessus, ce poste implique des déplacements professionnels pouvant aller jusqu’à 25 %, ce qui signifie que vous pourriez être amené(e) à voyager ponctuellement dans le cadre de cette fonction.
 
Gestion du Service
- Développe une compréhension des processus interfonctionnels du centre de données afin de soutenir les partenariats avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.
- Suit les formations requises en lien avec les domaines d’activité et les charges de travail du poste (par exemple : réparation, déploiement, changement simple, mise hors service, environnement informatique critique) dans les délais impartis selon les directives de la hiérarchie directe. Observe les techniciens plus expérimentés pour acquérir une expérience pratique et une formation pertinente sur le terrain (OJT). Peut suivre des formations supplémentaires pour obtenir ou maintenir des certifications techniques ou industrielles pertinentes.
- Escalade les problèmes et/ou demande conseil aux techniciens expérimentés ou à la hiérarchie directe concernant les interactions avec les clients.
- Maintient une connaissance des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) via les tableaux de bord et les systèmes de suivi, en vue des discussions mensuelles sur la performance individuelle, si nécessaire.
Exigences physiques
S’applique notamment, mais pas exclusivement, aux postes en centre de données basés aux États-Unis :
- Montée occasionnelle d’échelles.
- Montée fréquente d’escaliers et/ou de rampes.
- Station debout prolongée. Levage occasionnel de charges de 22,5 kg / 50 lb.
- Poussée ou traction occasionnelle de charges de 22,5 à 34 kg / 50 à 75 lb avec dispositif d’assistance.
- Acuité visuelle normale (vision de près, de loin et périphérique avec correction), définie selon les termes médicaux standards et les critères applicables.
- Vision des couleurs normale requise pour les travaux électriques, définie selon les termes médicaux standards et les critères applicables.
 
Prestation de service
- Suit les procédures pour communiquer, signaler et escalader immédiatement tout incident technique ou lié à la sécurité dans le centre de données auprès de la hiérarchie directe. Peut participer à des appels de coordination (« bridge calls ») pour fournir des détails sur l’état de l’incident et exécuter les actions de suivi sur site selon les directives, si nécessaire.
- Développe et applique une stratégie d’ordre d’exécution efficace pour les tâches assignées. Prépare, organise, installe et effectue les démarrages et arrêts de base du matériel (par exemple : baies, disques durs, commutateurs) selon des instructions écrites spécifiques fournies via des listes de contrôle, des guides, des processus standards, des courriels, des conseils de techniciens ou des directives de la direction. Peut effectuer certaines tâches en collaboration avec d’autres techniciens afin de respecter les procédures et exigences de sécurité.
- Réalise des diagnostics et des dépannages et/ou utilise des procédures standards pour identifier rapidement et efficacement la ou les causes des problèmes techniques, et remplacer les composants défectueux dans les équipements réseau, de stockage ou de serveur, avec une perturbation nulle ou minimale pour le client et/ou l’activité. Reconnaît les conditions, circonstances et scénarios pouvant avoir un impact significatif sur le client ou l’entreprise dans l’environnement du centre de données.
- Effectue directement les mises hors service, les changements simples (par exemple : mises à niveau de mémoire, réinstallation du système d’exploitation) et les renouvellements de câblage d’infrastructure, d’équipements réseau, de stockage et de serveurs, en suivant les procédures standards avec un minimum de supervision. Traite les dispositifs contenant des données (DBD) pour destruction ou confirme que tous les dispositifs concernés (par exemple : disques durs, disques SSD, cartes mémoire, etc.) contenus dans les équipements réseau, de stockage ou de serveur ont été identifiés pour éradication ou destruction.
- Peut effectuer une vérification post-exécution de la mise à la terre, de l’organisation, de l’étiquetage et du câblage afin de s’assurer de la conformité avec tous les protocoles de sécurité, les standards de déploiement et les modèles de conception réseau planifiés (NDT), avec accompagnement. Peut identifier des erreurs dans les standards de déploiement ou les modèles de conception réseau (NDT) et les signaler aux techniciens ou spécialistes concernés pour coordonner les corrections nécessaires, avec accompagnement.
Conditions de travail
- S’applique notamment, mais pas exclusivement, aux postes en centre de données basés aux États-Unis : travail pendant de longues périodes dans un environnement présentant des niveaux élevés de bruit ambiant, de chaleur et de lumière, en raison des équipements et des systèmes de ventilation nécessaires.
Capacité à travailler par quarts de 12 heures, y compris pendant des horaires non standards pouvant inclure le soir, la nuit, les week-ends et/ou les jours fériés.
Comme indiqué dans la description du poste, ce rôle implique des déplacements professionnels pouvant aller jusqu’à 25 %, ce qui signifie que vous pourriez être amené(e) à voyager ponctuellement dans le cadre de cette fonction.

You will provide input for suggested modifications to these processes and procedures as needed to improve service quality and efficiency while providing guidance to other technicians. Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays.

Datacenter Operations- Reviews Process Change Notifications (PCNs) and develops an understanding of the impact to work execution and awareness to changes within their area of work and/or the work of others. Incorporates security requirements in feedback and process changes, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices.

Escalates issues related to compliance or operational assurance activities to direct-line management. Participates in the regular cadence of proactive safety observation reporting processes and systems. 
- Completes required security and data management training while complying with security and data management procedures/policies with guidance from other technicians. Appropriately takes action and reports physical security access concerns and/or incidents to direct-line management or via established reporting methods.

Proactively shares security-related learnings and best practices within team. 
- As indicated above, have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays. 
- As indicated above, this role has a travel requirement of up to 25% which means you may be required to travel, from time to time, as part of this role.

- Escalates and/or seeks guidance from experienced technicians or direct-line management regarding client interactions. 
- Develops an understanding of cross-functional Data Center processes to support partnerships with internal and external stakeholders. 
- Completes required training aligned to job focus areas and workloads (i.e., Break fix, Deployment, Simple Change, Decommission, IT Critical Environment) in a timely manner per direct-line management assignment(s). Observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training (OJT). May complete additional or supplemental training to obtain or maintain relevant industry or technical certifications.

Occasional lifting 50lbs / 22.5kg. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg. with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.
Service Delivery- Develops an understanding of effective execution order strategy(ies) for assigned tasks with assistance from experienced technicians or direct-line management. Prepares, stages, sets up, and performs basic startups and shutdowns for hardware (e.g., racks, hard drives, switches) according to specific written instructions provided via checklists, guides, standard processes, emails, guidance from other technicians, and/or direction from management. May perform tasks in tandem with other technicians to comply with procedures and safety requirements. Ensures all tasks are executed and aligned with security principles, configurations, and controls.

This role supports Microsoft’s global subsidiary governance framework, helping ensure subsidiaries operate in compliance with corporate governance requirements, local law, and internal policies, while enabling Microsoft’s evolving business needs, including acquisitions, datacenter expansion, and entity lifecycle activities.
In the role of Corporate Counsel, Subsidiary Management, you will partner with senior attorneys and cross‑functional stakeholders on a range of matters related to Microsoft’s global subsidiaries, including legal entity/corporate structure, dividend planning and execution, subsidiary funding (including datacenter funding), and legal entity lifecycle activities such as integrations and entity terminations. You will support the day‑to‑day execution of Microsoft’s centralized governance model and work closely with regional legal teams, Tax, Treasury, Corporate Accounting, and Finance to address complex governance issues across jurisdictions.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and we are dedicated to this mission across every aspect of our company. Our Culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. Join us and help shape the future of the world. 

Responsibilities
Legal Advice and Counsel
 
- Provide legal advice and support on corporate governance matters affecting Microsoft’s global subsidiaries and corporate structure.
- Support a range of subsidiary management matters, including complex governance and compliance issues across jurisdictions, dividend planning and execution, subsidiary funding (including datacenter funding), and legal entity integrations and terminations.
- Partner with Tax, Treasury, Corporate Accounting, and other CELA teams, as well as regional counsel, to support governance decisions and execution.
- Draft, review and manage intercompany agreements, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders, and leveraging AI-enabled tools and workflows to support standardization, efficiency, and scalability across Microsoft’s global subsidiary structure.
- Draft, review, and manage corporate governance documentation, including board and shareholder resolutions, director and officer appointments and removals, and powers of attorney.
- Assist with legal entity lifecycle activities, including integration of acquired entities and execution of legal entity rationalization or termination initiatives.
 
Operational Excellence
- Apply technology, including AI, to improve legal work and efficiency.
- Support the implementation of governance solutions that mitigate legal risk and promote consistency across Microsoft subsidiaries.
- Contribute to the development and improvement of governance processes, standards, and tools to support efficiency and scalability.
- Identify opportunities for operational improvements and work with senior attorneys to enhance subsidiary management practices.
 
Culture
- Embody our culture and values
 

Qualifications
Minimum Required Qualifications:
- Juris Doctor Degree or international equivalent degree AND 1+ year(s) experience as a practicing attorney-  OR equivalent experience.

- Active license to practice law in a jurisdiction and capable of meeting admission requirements in relevant jurisdiction
 
Additional Preferred Qualifications: 
- Juris Doctor Degree or international equivalent degree AND 2+ years experience as a practicing attorney- OR equivalent experience.

- 1+ years experience as an attorney in multinational companies with global subsidiary structures
- 1+ years experience using AI to improve legal work and efficiency
